text: Explain procedure to mother and obtain consent
Set trolley to patient bed side
Provide privacy, protect beddings with markingtouch
Position baby and remove top clothing
Mix tepid water, test with bath thermometer/ elbow
Soak first flannel, squeeze out water lightly, use to damp and clean body
Place wet flannel on forehead, armpit and trunk
Recheck body temperature hourly until temp. is down
Administer prescribe medications e.g. antipyretics, anti-malaria, pain relief.
